subject: Are there any defining features of "session" or any method to check if an object is a shiny session?

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Are there any defining features of "session" or any method to check if an object is a shiny session?
parts: Suppose I write a function that takes a Shiny session as an argument.  How do I check if the given argument is indeed a Shiny session?  I was hoping there would be a special class on it, but it seems that it's simply an environment, are there any other identifying attributes I could use?
